name: exception-referent-v1
declared: 2026-10-08, before the detector was run on any case
purpose: Offline check: can a cited passage be flagged when it contains an exception sentence with a vague referent ('This requirement does not apply...') that follows a list of two or more items, so the exception could attach to any of them? Advisory; tells the product to fetch linked evidence or state the ambiguity.
finding_behind_it: E23: S045 says 'This requirement does not apply when...' directly after three bullets (close, block, list). Linked complete evidence shows the exceptions waive listing only. The retrieved passage alone supports a broader reading, so the cause is evidence ambiguity, not a generation slip.
inputs: Saved independent review bundle, cited passages only, development cases only. No model calls. Holdout not read.

rule.exception_sentence: a sentence matching: (this|these|that|the above) (requirement|requirements|rule|rules|condition|conditions|step|steps) (does|do) not apply, or the same with 'is not required' / 'are not required'
rule.list_before: the passage text before that sentence contains at least 2 list-item lines (lines starting with a dash, en dash, bullet or numbering)
rule.flagged_if: both hold in the same passage

thresholds.T2_control_false_flags: 0 flagged cited passages in E10, E30, E46
thresholds.T3_false_flag_rate: at most 3 of the cases rated correctness 2 contain any flagged cited passage

decision_rule: Pass only if T1, T2 and T3 all hold. Otherwise record as rejected for this version; revisions get a new version, not edits.
descriptive_only: List every flagged passage and case with the exception sentence, for source review.
limits: One known defect only, so T1 is a single example, not recall
Rule written after reading E23, so not independent; holdout is the independent test
Pattern is English and Mastercard-guide shaped; other sources may phrase exceptions differently
Advisory only; ambiguity flag does not say which reading is right
